properties.name: agentspaces.transport.quic.enabled
properties.description: Register the quic binding. Needs ai.badmonkey.agentspaces:agentspaces-transport-quic on the classpath.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.quic.bind
properties.description: host:port the quic binding listens on and advertises; blank registers it for dialing only.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.quic.advertise
properties.description: host:port carried in the advertisement in place of bind (a NAT or pod address).

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.quic.priority
properties.description: Advertised endpoint priority (spec 5.5), lower dials first; default: after the agentspaces.bind endpoint, in block order.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.dtls.enabled
properties.description: Register the dtls binding. Needs ai.badmonkey.agentspaces:agentspaces-transport-dtls on the classpath.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.dtls.bind
properties.description: host:port the dtls binding listens on and advertises; blank registers it for dialing only.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.dtls.advertise
properties.description: host:port carried in the advertisement in place of bind (a NAT or pod address).

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.dtls.priority
properties.description: Advertised endpoint priority (spec 5.5), lower dials first; default: after the agentspaces.bind endpoint, in block order.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.dtls.attestation
properties.description: identity: attest with the identity-endorsed channel certificate, or CA mode when agentspaces.transport.tls.trust-store is set. none: encryption only, never attesting.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.dtls.protocols
properties.description: DTLS versions offered. DTLSv1.2 is what BouncyCastle negotiates today; DTLSv1.3 is refused until it does.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.dtls.connection-id
properties.description: Negotiate RFC 9146 Connection ID so an association survives NAT rebinding.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.dtls.mtu
properties.description: Datagram budget: the largest UDP payload sent, 576 to 9000 bytes.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.dtls.window
properties.description: DATA PDUs unacknowledged per association, 4 to 1024.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.dtls.idle-timeout
properties.description: Silence after which an association fails, 10s to 10m; keepalive at a quarter of it.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.dtls.max-half-open
properties.description: Unfinished handshakes per listener, 16 to 65536.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.dtls.hello-rate-per-source
properties.description: ClientHellos accepted per second from one source address, 1 to 1000. Raise it for many peers behind one NAT address.

properties.name: agentspaces.multicast.seal
properties.description: Seal each multicast beacon datagram under its group's content-key (SPEC 10.1 v0.1.19): members holding the key find each other, bystanders read nothing; groups without a content key stay plain.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.udp.enabled
properties.description: Register the bare UDP binding (plaintext; frames stay signed). Needs ai.badmonkey.agentspaces:agentspaces-transport-dtls and the dev-local profile or allow-plaintext.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.udp.bind
properties.description: host:port the udp binding listens on and advertises; blank registers it for dialing only.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.udp.advertise
properties.description: host:port carried in the advertisement in place of bind.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.udp.priority
properties.description: Advertised endpoint priority; default after the other listeners.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.udp.allow-plaintext
properties.description: Permit plaintext UDP outside the dev-local security profile. No confidentiality, no attestation; an on-path attacker can disrupt delivery.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.webrtc.enabled
properties.description: Register the webrtc binding and accept offers, advertising Endpoint(webrtc, sig, priority). Needs ai.badmonkey.agentspaces:agentspaces-transport-webrtc (and its native classifier) on the classpath. Attests, so it may run under require-attestation.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.webrtc.priority
properties.description: Advertised priority of the sig endpoint (spec 5.5), lower dials first; default: after every stream endpoint.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.webrtc.ice-servers
properties.description: ICE servers, each with urls (stun:, turn:, turns:) and the TURN username and credential; empty by default, so only host and mDNS candidates gather.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.webrtc.dial-timeout
properties.description: A dial (signalling, ICE, DTLS, channel open) completes or fails within this; a pending session expires at it.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.webrtc.offers-per-peer-per-minute
properties.description: OFFER signals accepted from one remote peer per minute; excess is dropped and counted.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.webrtc.candidates-per-session
properties.description: CAND signals accepted for one session; excess is dropped and counted.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.webrtc.max-signal-bytes
properties.description: The largest signal body accepted.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.webrtc.offload.frames-per-minute
properties.description: The relay offload (SRAD agentspaces-js JS-W-11): once more than this many frames crossed a relay to or from one member in a sliding minute, the node dials that member's webrtc endpoint from its tick (never from a send) and sends directly once open. A setting, not a cap.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.webrtc.offload.retry-after
properties.description: How long the node waits after a failed offload dial to a member before dialing it again; the relay carries the frames meanwhile.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.ws.enabled
properties.description: Register the ws binding (WebSocket, plaintext). Needs ai.badmonkey.agentspaces:agentspaces-transport-http on the classpath.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.ws.bind
properties.description: host:port[/path] the ws binding listens on and advertises; blank registers it for dialing only.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.ws.advertise
properties.description: host:port[/path] carried in the advertisement in place of bind (an ingress or NAT address).

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.ws.priority
properties.description: Advertised endpoint priority (spec 5.5), lower dials first; default: after the agentspaces.bind endpoint, in block order.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.ws.path
properties.description: The path served.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.ws.allowed-origins
properties.description: Browser origins allowed to connect (scheme://host[:port]); empty refuses every browser; * admits any, for demonstrations.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.ws.idle-timeout
properties.description: A connection or exchange session silent this long closes.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.ws.ping-interval
properties.description: A WebSocket idle this long for writing sends a ping.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.ws.long-poll
properties.description: How long an exchange download request is held with nothing to send.

properties.name: agentspaces.transport.ws.opens-per-source-per-second
properties.description: Exchange sessions one source address may open per second; a rate, never a cap on sessions.

properties.name: agentspaces.security.grants.raft-client
properties.description: Peers or agents that may submit commands to an ordered log without voting (RAFT_CLIENT: browsers and the Python and TypeScript peers taking through the log); empty permits every admitted member.

properties.name: agentspaces.store.enabled
properties.description: This peer is a content store (srad/agentspaces-pdt2.md P2-S-10): one ContentStore per group over its Pdt facade; the swarm advertises pdt=2. Needs agentspaces.content.enabled and agentspaces.pdt.enabled.

properties.name: agentspaces.store.name
properties.description: The card name (asset content-store:<name>); the peer id when blank (P2-S-01).

properties.name: agentspaces.store.capacity
properties.description: Required: the bytes the store holds, such as 2TiB (P2-S-05).

properties.name: agentspaces.store.reserve
properties.description: The bytes kept free below the capacity: a size or a percentage (P2-S-05).

properties.name: agentspaces.store.max-object
properties.description: The largest root accepted (P2-S-05).

properties.name: agentspaces.store.lease-default
properties.description: The lease of a pin asked by invoke without one (P2-S-04).

properties.name: agentspaces.store.lease-max
properties.description: The longest lease honoured (P2-S-04).

properties.name: agentspaces.store.copies-max
properties.description: The largest copies a pin may ask for (P2-S-03).

properties.name: agentspaces.store.accept-kinds
properties.description: The pin kinds taken: tree, artifact (P2-S-05).

properties.name: agentspaces.store.accept-requesters
properties.description: open, or grant: the requester needs CONTENT_FETCH on the root (P2-S-05, P2-Q-SEC-06). A grant store without an authorizer takes no pins, and its card says it waits for one.

properties.name: agentspaces.store.blind
properties.description: Hold sealed bytes only, without the content key (P2-S-08).

properties.name: agentspaces.store.tier
properties.description: hot or cold (P2-S-05).

properties.name: agentspaces.store.challenge-deadline
properties.description: How long a challenged store has to answer this peer's challenges (P2-S-07).

properties.name: agentspaces.store.price-per-gib-month
properties.description: The price hint on the card's costHints; 0 for none (P2-S-01).

properties.name: agentspaces.pdt.enabled
properties.description: Build one Pdt facade per group over the content swarm and advertise trees=1 (srad/agentspaces-pdt.md PD-C-02, PD-X-01). Needs agentspaces.content.enabled=true.

properties.name: agentspaces.pdt.space
properties.description: The space each group's ref heads (PRef entries) live in.

properties.name: agentspaces.pdt.inline-delta
properties.description: Largest delta carried on a head, in bytes, at most 32768 (PD-X-07).

properties.name: agentspaces.pdt.load-timeout
properties.description: How long a lazy load or a deref waits for a node or a delta (PD-V-06).

properties.name: agentspaces.pdt.follow
properties.description: full: a reader fetches each new head's tree as it arrives; lazy: nodes load on get (PD-X-10).

values.description: One directory per root under agentspaces.content.store.path/<group>; a restart reads it back.
Every piece once under its sha2-256 in agentspaces.content.store.path/<group>.hash, shared by every root that names it (PDT 2, P2-H-01 to P2-H-04); not with encrypt-at-rest.
On the heap; lost on restart.
Serves published files where they lie.

properties.name: agentspaces.pdt.sealing
properties.description: The sealing every head names: group-key, sealed-nodes, or none (PD-P-03, PD-P-05). A group without a content-key names none.

properties.name: agentspaces.pdt.store.kind
properties.description: pack: the append-only pack store under path/<group>; memory: on the heap; bean: the application's NodeStore bean, which also wins over the other kinds when present (PD-S-02).

properties.name: agentspaces.pdt.store.path
properties.description: The pack directory. Blank with kind=pack falls back to memory with a warning, or refuses to start under store.require (PD-Q-AVL-02).

properties.name: agentspaces.pdt.store.quota
properties.description: The store quota in bytes (PD-S-05); 0 is unbounded. Every node the content swarm hands the store passes it, and a fetch past it fails with the refusal (PDT 2 phase 7, P2-X-08).

properties.name: agentspaces.pdt.store.require
properties.description: Refuse to start without a durable store: a pack store with a path, or a NodeStore bean (PD-Q-AVL-02).

properties.name: agentspaces.pdt.retain.versions
properties.description: Versions kept per ref as delta bases (PD-S-03).

properties.name: agentspaces.pdt.retain.age
properties.description: Age kept per ref as delta bases (PD-S-03).

properties.name: agentspaces.pdt.refs
properties.description: Per-ref settings by ref name: refs.<name>.mode (multi or linear, PD-R-04) and refs.<name>.follow (full or lazy, PD-X-10), the ref's own follow in place of agentspaces.pdt.follow (PDT 2 phase 7, P2-X-08).

properties.name: agentspaces.pdt.spaces
properties.description: Per-space escalation by space name (srad/agentspaces-pdt.md group E): spaces.<name>.escalate-above (bytes, 0 off) opts the space into the persistent trees, so a payload above it travels as a tree and a later version as its delta, unsealed before escalation with the record naming the key epoch (PD-E-01, PD-E-04); spaces.<name>.require (PD-E-06) refuses a write a member without the tree exchange could not receive, naming the members, where the default falls back to the flat content swarm. Needs agentspaces.pdt.enabled=true.

properties.name: agentspaces.discovery.cache.max-entries
properties.description: The most advertisements each group's cache holds (SPEC §6.3). Unset: 8192, times four on a RENDEZVOUS peer; a set value applies as given. A full cache refuses a new id and counts adsRefusedCacheFull.

properties.name: agentspaces.discovery.cache.max-bytes
properties.description: The byte budget of each group's cache, the sum of its advertisements' encodings (SPEC §6.3, v0.1.32). Unset: 33554432 (32 MiB), times four on a RENDEZVOUS peer; a set value applies as given. A new id, or a newer version, that would pass it is refused and counted in adsRefusedCacheFull.

properties.name: agentspaces.discovery.spill.max-fetch-bytes
properties.description: The largest parts document a stub card's resolution fetches from the content swarm (SPEC §6.1a.5, v0.1.32), in bytes; a larger one fails at once and counts spillsOverLimit.

values.description: Fetch each new head's tree as the head arrives.
Fetch nothing on a head; load nodes on get (PD-V-06).
On the heap; lost on restart.
One directory per root under agentspaces.content.store.path/<group>; a restart reads it back.
Every piece once under its sha2-256 in agentspaces.content.store.path/<group>.hash, shared by every root that names it (PDT 2, P2-H-01 to P2-H-04); not with encrypt-at-rest.
On the heap; lost on restart.
Serves published files where they lie.
Nodes travel sealed under the group's content key.
Each node sealed on its own (PD-P-05).
